14646-christopher-and-columbus.title: Christopher And Columbus
14646-christopher-and-columbus.creator: Unknown
14646-christopher-and-columbus.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Both had had their seventeenth birthday--and what a birthday: no cake, no candles, no kisses and wreaths and home-made poems; but then, as Anna-Felicitas pointed out, to comfort Anna-Rose who was taking it hard, you can't get blood out of an aunt--only a month before. Both were very German outside and very English inside.

arxiv-2203-03613.title: Bayesian Bilinear Neural Network for Predicting the Mid-price Dynamics in Limit-Order Book Markets
arxiv-2203-03613.creator: Martin Magris, Mostafa Shabani, Alexandros Iosifidis
arxiv-2203-03613.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Martin Magris, Mostafa Shabani, Alexandros Iosifidis. The prediction of financial markets is a challenging yet important task. In modern electronically-driven markets, traditional time-series econometric methods often appear incapable of capturing the true complexity of the multi-level interactions driving the price dynamics. While recent research has established the effectiveness of traditional machine learning (ML) models in financial applications, their intrinsic inability to deal with uncertainties, which is a great concern in econometrics research and real business applications, constitutes a major drawback.

arxiv-2203-08735.title: Recovery of piecewise smooth density and Lamé parameters from high-frequency exterior Cauchy data
arxiv-2203-08735.creator: Sombuddha Bhattacharyya, Maarten V. de Hoop, Vitaly Katsnelson, Gunther Uhlmann
arxiv-2203-08735.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sombuddha Bhattacharyya, Maarten V. de Hoop, Vitaly Katsnelson, Gunther Uhlmann. We consider an isotropic elastic medium occupying a bounded domain Ω ⊂ ℝ 3 \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{3} whose density and Lamé parameters are piecewise smooth. In the elastic wave initial value inverse problem, we are given the solution operator for the elastic wave equation, but only outside Ω \Omega and only for initial data supported outside Ω \Omega , and we study the recovery of the density and Lamé parameters.

arxiv-2308-05147.title: From Dirac to Majorana: the Cosmic Neutrino Background capture rate in the minimally extended Standard Model
arxiv-2308-05147.creator: Yuber F. Perez-Gonzalez, Manibrata Sen
arxiv-2308-05147.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yuber F. Perez-Gonzalez, Manibrata Sen. We investigate the capture rate of the cosmic neutrino background on tritium within the Standard Model, extended to incorporate three right-handed singlet neutrinos with explicit lepton-number violation. We consider a scenario where the 6 × 6 6\times 6 neutrino mixing matrix factorizes into three independent 2 × 2 2\times 2 pairs and analyze the states produced from weak interactions just before neutrino decoupling.

arxiv-2405-00072.title: Role of local anisotropy in hybrid stars
arxiv-2405-00072.creator: Luiz L. Lopes, H. C. Das
arxiv-2405-00072.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Luiz L. Lopes, H. C. Das. Using the Bower-Liang model, we discuss how pressure anisotropies affect the microscopic and macroscopic properties of hybrid stars. We find that anisotropies affect the maximum mass, central density, and radius of the canonical stars. Anisotropies also affect the minimum neutron star mass that presents quarks in their core, as well as the total amount of quarks for the maximally massive stars.

arxiv-2408-15530.title: Nonlinear soft-tissue elasticity, remodeling, and degradation described by an extended Finsler geometry
arxiv-2408-15530.creator: J.D. Clayton
arxiv-2408-15530.description: Abstract A continuum mechanical theory incorporating an extension of Finsler geometry is formulated for fibrous soft solids. Especially if of biologic origin, such solids are nonlinear elastic with evolving microstructures. For example, elongated cells or collagen fibers can stretch and rotate independently of motions of their embedding matrix.

arxiv-2501-09816.title: Galaxy Morphological Classification with Zernike Moments and Machine Learning Approaches.
arxiv-2501-09816.creator: Hamed Ghaderi, Nasibe Alipour, Hossein Safari
arxiv-2501-09816.description: Abstract Classifying galaxies is an essential step for studying their structures and dynamics. Using GalaxyZoo2 (GZ2) fractions thresholds, we collect 545 and 11,735 samples in non-galaxy and galaxy classes, respectively. We compute the Zernike moments (ZMs) for GZ2 images, extracting unique and independent characteristics of galaxies.

arxiv-2507-20600.title: Random measurements are almost maximally incompatible
arxiv-2507-20600.creator: Andreas Bluhm, Cécilia Lancien, Ion Nechita
arxiv-2507-20600.description: Abstract . In this work, we investigate the incompatibility of random quantum measurements. Most previous work has focused on characterizing the maximal amount of white noise that any fixed number of incompatible measurements with a fixed number of outcomes in a fixed dimension can tolerate before becoming compatible.

arxiv-2510-02280.title: An efficient quantum algorithm for computing S S -units and its applications
arxiv-2510-02280.creator: Jean-François Biasse, Fang Song
arxiv-2510-02280.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jean-François Biasse, Fang Song. In this paper, we provide details on the proofs of the quantum polynomial time algorithm of Biasse and Song (SODA 16) for computing the S S -unit group of a number field. This algorithm directly implies polynomial time methods to calculate class groups, S S -class groups, relative class group and the unit group, ray class groups, solve the principal ideal problem, solve certain norm equations, and decompose ideal classes in the ideal class group.

britannica-1911-fitz-osbern-william.title: Fitz-Osbern, William (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fitz-osbern-william.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fitz-osbern-william.description: Article 'Fitz-Osbern, William' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was an intimate friend of William the Conqueror, and the principal agent in preparing for the invasion of England. He received the earldom of Hereford with the special duty of pushing into Wales. During William’s absence in 1067, Fitz-Osbern was left as his deputy in central England, to guard it from the Welsh on one side, and the Danes on the other.

britannica-1911-levertin-oscar-ivan.title: Levertin, Oscar Ivan (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-levertin-oscar-ivan.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-levertin-oscar-ivan.description: Article 'Levertin, Oscar Ivan' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. man of letters, was born of Jewish parents at Norrköping on the 17th of July 1862. He received his doctorate in letters at Upsala in 1887, and was subsequently docent at Upsala, and later professor of literature at Stockholm. Enforced sojourns in southern Europe on account of health familiarized him with foreign languages.

pmc-10673349.creator: Gaetano Riemma, Giampaolo Mainini, David Lukanović, Gaetano Scalzone, Lucia Sandullo, Maria Teresa Schettino, Maria Giovanna Vastarella, Mattia Dominoni, Gorizio Pieretti, Pasquale De Franciscis, Mario Passaro, Marco Torella, Francesco Dessole
pmc-10673349.description: Background and Objectives: Signs and symptoms of vulvovaginitis, especially when recurrent, have a significant impact on a woman’s quality of life. The aim of this study was to survey gynecologists about their habits regarding the treatments of the pathology and to evaluate the efficacy of a novel vaginal hydrogel composed of wheat extracts and polyhexanide aimed at reducing vulvovaginitis symptomatology.

pmc-11738768.title: Antiviral activity of vitamin D derivatives against severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus in vitro and in vivo
pmc-11738768.creator: Chongda Luo, Xintong Yan, Shaokang Yang, Sichen Ren, Yan Luo, Jiazheng Li, Ping Wang, Yunfeng Shao, Wei Li, Song Li, Jingjing Yang, Ruiyuan Cao, Wu Zhong
pmc-11738768.description: Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV) is a tick-borne virus that causes the severe fever thrombocytopenia syndrome, which manifests as fever and haemorrhage, accompanied by severe neurological complications. To date, no specific antiviral drugs have been approved for this indication. Herein, we investigated whether vitamin D derivatives inhibit SFTSV both in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-12571137.description: BackgroundCHA2DS2-VASc score in cardiac amyloidosis (CA) with atrial fibrillation (AF) is believed to underestimate ischemic stroke risk, necessitating a better predictive model.MethodsData were obtained from the National Readmission Database (NRD). Outcomes between CA-AF and no-CA-AF were compared using multivariate regression analysis to calculate adjusted odds ratios (aORs).

pmc-13261103.title: Genome‐Wide DNA Methylation Changes Induced by High‐Fat Diet and Methyl Donor Supplementation in Female Lupus Models: An Exploratory Study
pmc-13261103.creator: Amanda Alves Ribeiro, Lucas Moura Carvalho, Jhulia Caroline Nunes Leal da Mota, Leticia Lobato Souza, Marcela Augusta de Souza Pinhel, Carla Barbosa Nonino, Bidossessi Wilfried Hounkpe, Walcy Paganelli Rosolia Teodoro, Nicolas Costa‐Fraga, Andrea Gonzales Izquierdo, Angel Diaz‐Lagares, Ana Belen Cru
pmc-13261103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This exploratory study investigated the interactive effects of dietary fat content and methyl‐donor supplementation on genome‐wide DNA methylation in adipose tissue of female lupus‐prone NZBWF1/J mice. Thirty mice were randomly assigned to four groups for 12 weeks in a 2 × 2 factorial design: standard diet (SD, n = 7), high‐fat diet (HFD, n = 7), standard diet supplemented (SDS, n = 8), and high‐fat diet supplemented (HFDS, n = 8).

pmc-13399099.creator: Qijie Zhao, Xiao Cai, Xing Wang, Jing Jin
pmc-13399099.description: BackgroundPatients with diabetes are at an increased risk of heart failure. The triglyceride‐glucose index increases the risk of diabetes‐related heart failure (dHF). We aimed to validate a practical clinical risk score for dHF in a large diabetic cohort and assess whether this score can identify dHF patients with an elevated triglyceride‐glucose (TyG) index who have poor outcomes.

pmc-13470158.title: Morquio syndrome masquerading as juvenile idiopathic Arthritis: A case report
pmc-13470158.creator: Zeineb Alaoui Kadiri, Imane El Binoune, Bouchra Amine, Anbar Kabbaj, Salma Zemrani, Samira Rostom, Bahiri Rachid
pmc-13470158.description: Morquio syndrome, or Mucopolysaccharidosis type IV (MPS IV), is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by enzyme deficiencies involved in glycosaminoglycan degradation. Progressive accumulation of these molecules leads to skeletal dysplasia, joint deformities, and variable systemic complications. Early features may mimic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), delaying diagnosis.
